_about: WHO LIVES WHERE ACROSS THE REGION'S PLACES (PEOPLE, 10/17/26, rule 110 swing, under the hold). A bank, draft:true, NOT read by the game. For each of the 26 places (14 valley seats from engine/bohemia_towns.js derive() on seed 1337, act 1; 12 region places from slices/bohemia_region.js) the Battle Brothers settlement class and terrain it stands in for, the base hire roll copied from the wiki's Character Backgrounds/Sources table for that exact cell (percent = the chance per vacant recruit slot), the +n tilts from the attached locations, buildings and situations our real ground stands in for (+1 is roughly 2-3 / 3-5 / 6-8.5 percent for a large / medium / small settlement, the page's own footnote), and the Bohemia skin of each background name. Numbers are the page's, copied by tools, never typed; the class, terrain and attachment choices are this lane's reading and are draft.

source.page_note: The table is missing the backgrounds from the Blazing Deserts DLC; Southern Assassin, Nomad, Gladiator, Indebted, Manhunter are hired only in the City-States with very few exceptions (the page's own words).

bb_classes.our_tier_to_class: fortress -> City or Citadel; town -> Medium Village or Stone Keep; camp -> Small Village or Wooden Keep; military only where the real place is a garrison (Remnants, Hoover Dam, Indian Springs)

skin._about: The Bohemia skin of each Battle Brothers background name on the Sources page: who that man is in a Las Vegas economic apocalypse. Words only, draft:true (rule 15 amended 8/11: an attempt, never a decision). 'hire': false means the page gives the background no hire row at all (events only, or a DLC the table does not cover), so no post in this game should offer it by Battle Brothers' own book.

anatomist.is: a med student out of UNLV who cuts without a licence now

apprentice.is: a kid out of the trade school, one year in

assassin.is: a hired killer; no post offers one, the page says events only

barbarian.is: a raider from the north; only the raiders origin starts with them

bastard.is: a boss's kid the boss never claimed

beast_slayer.is: a man who hunts what got out of the lab

beggar.is: a panhandler off the pedestrian bridges

bowyer.is: a reloader, hand-loads cartridges in a garage

butcher.is: a buffet butcher who still has his knives

cripple.is: a man the crash broke and nobody fixed

crusader.is: a holy soldier; no post offers one, events only

daytaler.is: a day labourer off the hardware-store lot

deserter.is: a man who walked off the base

disowned_noble.is: a casino family's kid who got cut off

eunuch.is: a rich house's trusted man with no family of his own (the page does give him a hire row, in cities and villages)

flagellant.is: a street preacher who punishes his own body

graverobber.is: a house-stripper, copper and anything else

hedge_knight.is: a private military contractor with his own kit

historian.is: an archivist from the university library

houndmaster.is: a K9 handler (the keepers' war-dog craft)

hunter.is: a desert hunter, bighorn and jackrabbit

juggler.is: a street performer off the Strip

killer_on_the_run.is: a man with a warrant and a state line in mind

kings_guard.is: no skin; no post offers one

lindwurm_slayer.is: no skin; no post offers one

mason.is: a concrete finisher, the dam's own trade

orc_slayer.is: no skin; no post offers one

pimp.is: a brothel's man; the page gives him no hire row, events only, so even Pahrump cannot hire one by the book

poacher.is: a poacher the game warden knows by name

ratcatcher.is: a pest-control man who knows the tunnels

refugee.is: somebody who came up I-15 with what fit in the car

shepherd.is: a cattle hand off the reservation

swordmaster.is: a range master, the gun school's own instructor

tailor.is: a costume-shop tailor (the runway's own trade)

witchhunter.is: a bounty hunter who works the cults

places.name: THE STRIP (Mob)
places.our_ground: resort, casino, convention, downtown (HOMES); holds the valley dam, 4 cells (minesOf seed 1337)
places.real: the Strip: 150,000 hotel rooms before the crash; the bars, the shows, the buffets; the dam cells the Mob holds inside the valley grid are a canon note (section 6)

places.name: NELLIS GATE (Remnants)
places.our_ground: arsenal, policestation, prison, firestation (HOMES)
places.real: Nellis AFB, Metro, the fire houses; the graph: military and law-enforcement survivors, military drones

places.name: THE DATAFORT (Network)
places.our_ground: datafort, radio, substation (HOMES)
places.real: the Switch data centers off I-15, the broadcast towers on Black Mountain; the graph: a manufactured origin, strongest outside ties

places.name: THE YARDS (Cartel)
places.our_ground: boneyard, landfill, quarry, railyard, storage, warehouse, terminal, swapmeet (HOMES); holds 50 solar cells (minesOf)
places.real: the Apex landfill (one of the biggest in the country), the Sloan gravel quarries, the UP railyard; the graph: organized predation, supply chains that mirror the Caravans

places.name: THE TRUCK STOP (Caravans)
places.our_ground: truckstop, terminal, swapmeet, warehouse (HOMES)
places.real: the I-15 truck stops, the Broadacres swap meet; the graph: neutral outside-world trade, everyone but the Cartel wants them alive

places.name: THE CHAPEL (Church)
places.our_ground: chapel, cemetery, school (HOMES)
places.real: the big evangelical churches, the cemeteries, the parish schools; the graph: best crisis organization, ceiling drops as the world heals

places.name: DOWNTOWN (Reds)
places.our_ground: downtown, cityhall, courthouse, mall (HOMES)
places.real: Fremont Street, city hall, the courthouse; the graph: the economic engine, not military

places.name: THE PARK (Blues)
places.our_ground: reservoir, watertreat, farm, park (HOMES)
places.real: the Wetlands Park, the water treatment plant, the last farm lots; the graph: environmentalist, large headcount

places.name: THE BLOCK PARTY (Anarchists)
places.our_ground: commercial (derived seat)
places.real: the Arts District bars and the warehouse parties; the graph: absorbed the Rockstar faction, culturally huge

places.name: THE SHOPS (Trades)
places.our_ground: industrial, solar, battery, warehouse (HOMES)
places.real: the industrial park off Dean Martin Drive, the union halls; the graph: skilled-worker guild, vehicle, solar and construction

places.name: THE CLINIC (Volunteers)
places.our_ground: medical, campus, granary, school (HOMES)
places.real: UMC, UNLV, the food bank warehouses; the graph: healthcare, education, food, knowledge, resource-poor by design

places.name: THE TUNNELS (Homeless)
places.our_ground: intake, pumpstation, reclaim, basin, wash (HOMES); holds 254 solar cells and the battery plant (minesOf)
places.real: the flood-tunnel people under the Strip (a real population of hundreds), the washes; the graph: tunnel HQ under the King Hobo, most Amalgamation-resistant

places.name: THE COLORFUL CAMP
places.our_ground: suburb (derived seat; no HOMES line, falls through to spread)
places.real: the graph: LGBTQ faction, smallest selectable, community-based not territorial, members across friendly factions

places.name: YOUR OWN CAMP (Custom)
places.our_ground: suburb (derived seat; the player faction)
places.real: the graph: the player faction, no preset philosophy; who lives here is who you brought

places.name: HENDERSON
places.our_ground: a region town on the road south-east
places.real: born as the Basic Magnesium plant in 1941 (magnesium for bombs, about 14,000 workers at its peak, sited for Hoover Dam power and Lake Mead water); the plant buildings later went to Titanium Metals and Kerr-McGee; now the valley's second city

places.name: BOULDER CITY
places.our_ground: a region town on the road to the dam
places.real: built in 1931 by the federal government for the dam workers; gambling banned by the city charter (one of two Nevada towns where it is illegal); the Nevada State Veterans Home is here, which is the Disbanded Troops line

places.name: HOOVER DAM
places.our_ground: a region fortress on the Colorado
places.real: the dam, the powerhouse, a federal security force at the gate since 2001; the water behind it is the valley's

places.name: LAKE MEAD MARINA
places.our_ground: a region camp on the shore
places.real: Hemenway Harbor: houseboats, the striped-bass fishery, the bathtub ring on the rock as the lake fell; the hippo pod from the beasts rounds lives on this water

places.name: JEAN
places.our_ground: a region camp on I-15 south
places.real: an exit with two casinos and a state prison conservation camp (the camp closes by July 2026, the inmates moved out); a dry-lake town

places.name: PRIMM
places.our_ground: a region town on the state line
places.real: three casinos and an outlet mall on the California line; the Ivanpah mirror fields next door (built 2014, its owners moving to close it from 2026, the regulator refusing in December 2025); everyone coming up I-15 arrives here first, which is the Refugees line

places.name: SEARCHLIGHT
places.our_ground: a region camp in the hills south
places.real: a gold camp from 1897 with over forty working mines, a few thousand people at its 1907 peak and fifty after the highway bypassed it in 1927; a living ghost town

places.name: INDIAN SPRINGS
places.our_ground: a region fortress on US-95 north
places.real: Creech Air Force Base (the drone base, MQ-9 Reapers flown from here, its own command since 2019) and High Desert State Prison (the largest in the state, about 4,000 beds) eight miles south of the town

places.name: MT CHARLESTON LODGE
places.our_ground: a region camp in the Spring Mountains
places.real: Kyle Canyon at 7,700 feet, ponderosa and bristlecone, the lodge itself burned to the ground on 17 September 2021; the Forest Service, the ski hill at Lee Canyon

places.name: PAHRUMP
places.our_ground: a region town over the pass west
places.real: Nye County: legal brothels, the Pahrump Valley Winery, alfalfa on well water, retirees; the Front Sight gun school (260,000 members, bankrupt 2022, sold and reopened as PrairieFire) is the Militia Barracks line

places.name: MOAPA
places.our_ground: a region camp up I-15 north
places.real: the Moapa River Reservation (Southern Paiute), the travel plaza, the alfalfa and dairy of the Moapa Valley, the 250 MW solar plant that opened in 2017 as the first utility-scale solar on tribal land, built where the Reid Gardner coal plant was shutting

places.name: MESQUITE
places.our_ground: a region town at the far north end of I-15
places.real: golf and three casinos on the Arizona line, Virgin River farms, retirees; Bunkerville next door is where the 2014 armed standoff over grazing happened, which is the Wooden Watchtower line
